Attune 0.0.16 fixes in-app updates for Linux system packages.

When an update needs to replace files under `/usr/lib/attune`, Attune now asks for administrator approval through Polkit, applies the update, and relaunches as the logged-in user. Linux updates continue to download and stage when the installation directory is root-owned.

To move from 0.0.15 or earlier to 0.0.16, install this package once with your package manager; older versions cannot request the required administrator approval. Future in-app updates use Polkit.

Windows and macOS update behavior is unchanged.
